correctness.rationale: Belletti--Detcherry Corollary 6.2(2), with k=d+1, supplies the required infinite connected compact hyperbolic family, all (Y_{d+1},T_n)-equivalent to M and pairwise non-embeddable under the stated rational-homology-sphere embedding hypothesis. That refined equivalence implies Y_{d+1}-equivalence and hence a common Y_1-class. Massuyeau Proposition 3.32 then directly gives equality of every Torelli-twist finite-type invariant of degree at most d, with arbitrary abelian target. The quantifiers and restrictions in the submitted result match the two published statements.

originality.rationale: The final claim is exactly a direct corollary of two published results. Belletti--Detcherry already produce the infinite pairwise non-embeddable hyperbolic family inside a single (Y_k,T_n)-equivalence class; Massuyeau already proves that Y_{d+1}-equivalence forces agreement of every finite-type invariant through degree d. Substituting k=d+1 yields the submitted conclusion verbatim at the level of mathematical implication. Under the audit rule that corollaries and special cases are covered even without identical wording, this cannot pass originality.
